# Radoslav Radev Recommends The Grease The Groove Method Of Spreading Attempts Across The Day

Radoslav Radev recommends the grease the groove method: instead of doing all attempts in one workout, spread them across the whole day with long rest between attempts, so every attempt is productive. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 06:17]

## Details

- Most people do their attempts one after another, but only the first two or three attempts are productive and the rest exhaust the nervous system for nothing. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 06:22]
- With the grease the groove method, you do one attempt, rest 30 minutes, another attempt, rest one hour, another attempt, spreading the whole workout across the day. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 06:42]
- It is possible every single next attempt to feel even better and to have even more strength because of the big rest between attempts. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 07:03]
- You can do like 10 attempts for one day for one skill, and every attempt is fresh and productive. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 07:11]
- You can alternate one attempt of planche and one attempt of pull with one hour rest, with a quick warm-up for five minutes again, and the body stays warmed up almost the whole day. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 08:15]

## Evidence

- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 06:17 (Radoslav Radev): "The rule number five. This is the most important and I save it for the end. Gracing the groove method. And this is what changed everything for me and also for my students."
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 06:22 (Radoslav Radev): "Most people do their attempts one after another. If you do six attempts only the first two three attempts are actually the most productive and the other three are just for you to feel better because you're doing a lot and you're actually exhausting your nervous system for nothing."
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 06:42 (Radoslav Radev): "Raising the groove method is completely different. Instead of doing all your attempts in one workout you spread them for the whole day. You do one attempt, rest 30 minutes, another attempt, one hour rest, another attempt and the whole day if you have the opportunity of course you can just spread the whole workout"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 07:03 (Radoslav Radev): "and by the way it's possible every single next attempt to feel it even better and to have even more strength so this is how you're making your workout much more productive"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 07:11 (Radoslav Radev): "you can just do like 10 attempts for one day for one skill so the reason of this workout is really simple guys you're actually doing the skill the whole day and you're not getting exhausted in the end of the day every attempt is fresh every attempt is productive"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 08:15 (Radoslav Radev): "you can alternate one attempt of plunge [planche] one attempt of pull one hour rest again quick warm-up for five minutes again one attempt and by the way when you warm up your body your body will be warmed up almost the whole day"
